title: Vector Competence Data Standard v1.0.0
description: A minimal flexible data standard viral vector competence studies

experiment_id.description: A unique identifier for each combination of virus-host-sample within a study. The identifier is composed of a prefix, pmid, and a seven digit identifier.

study.description: An abbreviated citation for the study in the format Last name of first author, et al. Year Journal

pmid.description: A unique integer used to identify works within the PubMed system. Not to be confused with a PubMed Central Identifier. See https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/about/public-access-info/ for additional details. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0001617 for definition.

doi.description: A centrally registered identifier symbol used to uniquely identify objects given by International DOI Foundation. The DOI system is commonly used for electronic documents such as journal articles. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0002110.

vector.description: The Linnaean classification of the vector on which the experiment was performed, reported as a species binomial. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName

vector_subspecies.description: Vector subspecies.  A taxonomic category below that of species. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C62700.

vector_strain.description: Vector strain. A genetic variant within a species. See https://w3id.org/evorao/strain.

vector_origin_country.description: The country that is the wild source for original vector collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/country

vector_origin_locality.description: The location that is the wild source for original vector collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality

vector_origin_year.description: The year when the wild source for original vector collection occurred. May also include season or other date information. Must contain a four digit year. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year

vector_generation.description: Vector generation in lab colony. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PCO_0000054

virus.description: The Linnaean classification of the virus with which the experiment was performed, reported as a species binomial. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName

viral_lineage.description: Information about the genetic distinctness of the sequenced organism below the subspecies level, e.g., serovar, serotype, biotype, ecotype, or any relevant genetic typing schemes. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0000020

viral_strain.description: Identifier given to a genetic variant within a single species. See https://w3id.org/evorao/strain

viral_genbank_accession.description: Accession number of an entry from the GenBank sequence database. See http://edamontology.org/data_2292

recombinant_virus.description: Is the virus derived from recombinant nucleic acid?

wildtype_mutant.description: Is the virus unmodified (wildtype) or has the genetic sequence of the virus been intentionally altered (mutant)? http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000480

viral_origin_locality.description: The location that is the wild source for original virus collection. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality

viral_origin_year.description: The year when the wild source for original virus collection occurred. May also include season or other date information. Must contain a four digit year. See http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year

viral_history_passage.description: Cell type and passage number. See https://w3id.org/evorao/passage
examples: Ae. triseriatus and Vero 12 alternate passages

viral_history_freshness.description: Specifies the conditions under which the product was stored to maintain stability and integrity, such as temperature, buffer, and other environmental factors. See https://w3id.org/evorao/storageConditions

host_exposure.description: Host species used for live animal exposure. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0001298

host_lineage_origin.description: Host intraspecific lineage name, or origin. See https://w3id.org/mixs/0000020

diagnostic_viremia.description: Diagnostic method used, if any, for measuring host viremia. See http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/D019411

titer.description: Concentration of virus in bloodmeal, intrathoracic inoculation or host viremia if live animal. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/VO_0000555

titer_units.description: Unit of measure for titer concentration. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C67375

dose.description: Dose of live virus injected via intrathoracic inoculation, if applicable. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25488

dose_units.description: Unit of measure for the dose. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C48463

mean_temp_reared.description: Average temperature recorded during rearing in celsius. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0001702

ampliture_temp_reared.description: Ampliture of temperature at which vectors are reared in Celsius. See http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000492

relative_humidity_reared.description: Percent relative humidity at which vectors are reared in Celsius. See http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002614

mean_temp_eit.description: Average temperature at which extrinsic incubation happens in Celsius. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0001702

ampliture_temp_eit.description: Ampliture of temperature at which extrinsic incubation happens in Celsius. See http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000492

relative_humidity_eit.description: Percent relative humidity at which vectors are reared in Celsius. See http://purl.allotrope.org/ontologies/result#AFR_0002614

coinfected.description: Is your mosquito knowingly infected with another organism. See http://www.ebi.ac.uk/efo/EFO_0010716

sample.description: Vector sample part used to establish infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100051

diagnostic.description: How vector infection was established. See http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/D019411

tested.description: Number of vectors tested for infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

positive.description: Number of vectors tested for infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

transmission_recipient.description: Host species used for live animal exposure.

transmission_diagnostic.description: Diagnostic method used to detect infection in animal. See http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/D019411

num_vector_fed.description: Number of vectors fed on the live animal. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

num_vector_positive.description: Number of infected vectors that fed on the live animal. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

num_recipients_tested.description: Number of recipient animals tested for infection. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463

num_recipients_positive.description: Number of recipient animals that tested positive. See http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25463
